Agent Name: InformationExtraction_Expert
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: They incorrectly assumed Bob could guess the exact number of coins in each box and thus win all 30 coins, ignoring the minimax nature of the game (Bob must choose guesses without knowing the distribution and the host can choose adversarially). They also overconstrained the distributions by forcing the smallest box to have at least 2 coins and setting c = a + 6 with a as the global minimum, excluding valid cases like (0,12,18). This led to the wrong conclusion of $30,000 instead of the correct guaranteed $16,000.
